task.topic: Among patients undergoing transcatheter aortic valve replacement, does new permanent pacemaker implantation affect subsequent clinical outcomes compared with no new permanent pacemaker implantation?

pico.population: Patients undergoing transcatheter aortic valve replacement or implantation
pico.exposure: New permanent pacemaker implantation after TAVR
pico.comparator: No new permanent pacemaker implantation after TAVR

targets.effect_selection_rule: Retain one all-cause-death arm-count comparison per independent report. Prefer the directly tabulated study-specific long-term comparison. Keep alternative timepoints as non-selected candidates when the report exposes incompatible risk sets.

field_definitions.new_ppm_deaths: All-cause deaths in the new post-TAVR PPM group.
field_definitions.new_ppm_total: Participants in the new PPM group.
field_definitions.no_new_ppm_deaths: All-cause deaths in the no-new-PPM group.

extraction_notes: Do not use mortality plus hospitalization composite endpoints.
Do not replace raw death counts with adjusted hazard ratios.
The source corpus contains timepoint-selection ambiguity; preserve each source timepoint in the extraction record.

extraction.model_selection_policy: Retain one all-cause-death arm-count comparison per independent report. Prefer the directly tabulated study-specific long-term comparison. Keep alternative timepoints as non-selected candidates when the report exposes incompatible risk sets.
extraction.exclusion_concepts: Do not use mortality plus hospitalization composite endpoints. Do not replace raw death counts with adjusted hazard ratios. The source corpus contains timepoint-selection ambiguity; preserve each source timepoint in the extraction record.
extraction.evidence_requirements: Every extracted record must retain exact source evidence, page, source-defined effect scale, exposure unit, adjustment set, and missingness.
